WinterOrb.name: Winter Orb
WinterOrb.description: Channel to conjure an orb above you, which pelts nearby enemies with projectiles that impact the ground and explode. Channelling for longer builds up stages on the skill. When you stop channelling, the stages decay over a duration.

SpiritOffering.name: Spirit Offering
SpiritOffering.description: Consumes a corpse, granting increased critical strike chance and additional critical strike multiplier to your minions. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

SummonRagingSpiritAltX.name: Summon Raging Spirit of Enormity
SummonRagingSpiritAltX.description: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.

StormBrandAltX.name: Storm Brand of Indecision
StormBrandAltX.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing a beam which deals damage to the branded enemy and those around it. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

FreezingPulse.name: Freezing Pulse
FreezingPulse.description: An icy projectile which has a chance to freeze enemies it passes through. The projectile fades quickly, reducing damage and freezing chance until it dissipates.

Incinerate.name: Incinerate
Incinerate.description: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a wave of fire damage over a wide and long area that will apply a powerful Ignite.

VaalSpark.name: Vaal Spark
VaalSpark.description: Continuously launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

BallLightning.name: Ball Lightning
BallLightning.description: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

DivineIreAltY.name: Divine Ire of Disintegration
DivineIreAltY.description: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages. Release to unleash this energy in a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect this skill. Maximum of 10 Stages.

KineticRainAltX.name: Kinetic Rain of Impact
KineticRainAltX.description: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage.

ColdSnap.name: Cold Snap
ColdSnap.description: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

PowerSiphon.name: Power Siphon
PowerSiphon.description: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.

Spellslinger.name: Spellslinger
Spellslinger.description: Reserves mana based on the supported spells to cause those spells to trigger when you fire projectiles from a wand attack.

Stormbind.name: Stormbind
Stormbind.description: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.

SupportAutomation.name: Automation
SupportAutomation.description: Supports spell skills that are instant and have no reservation. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

FlameDashAltY.name: Flame Dash of Return
FlameDashAltY.description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground, then repeat the teleport in the other direction. Cannot be triggered, or used by a totem, trap or mine. Cannot be supported by Unleash.

KineticRainKineticInstability.name: Kinetic Anomaly
KineticRainKineticInstability.description: Gathers kinetic energy into an anomaly at the targeted location, which will explode when enemies are near it, dealing your wand's damage in an area. The anomaly will dissipate after a duration.

BaneAltX.name: Bane of Condemnation
BaneAltX.description: Applies a debuff to enemies in a small area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

KineticFusilladeAltX.name: Kinetic Fusillade of Detonation
KineticFusilladeAltX.description: Wave your wand to create multiple hovering kinetic projectiles. After a short duration, the projectiles explode, dealing area damage. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.

LightningTrap.name: Lightning Trap
LightningTrap.description: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.

PurityOfLightning.name: Purity of Lightning
PurityOfLightning.description: Casts an aura that grants lightning resistance to you and your allies.

Zealotry.name: Zealotry
Zealotry.description: Casts an aura that grants bonuses to damage and critical strike chance of spells to you and your allies, and gives a chance to create Consecrated Ground against stronger enemies.

RaiseZombieAltX.name: Raise Zombie of Slamming
RaiseZombieAltX.description: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike and an area of effect slam.

KineticBolt.name: Kinetic Bolt
KineticBolt.description: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from.

IceNova.name: Ice Nova
IceNova.description: A circle of ice expands from the caster.

Wrath.name: Wrath
Wrath.description: Casts an aura that adds lightning damage to the attacks of you and your allies, and makes your spells deal more lightning damage.

Wither.name: Wither
Wither.description: Casts a debilitating debuff on enemies in an area, hindering their movement and also inflicts the Withered debuff, which increases the Chaos Damage they take and can stack up to 15 times.

SomaticShell.name: Somatic Shell
SomaticShell.description: Fire a damaging projectile from your wand which aims itself towards an enemy and applies a shell to the first enemy struck. Damage from hits against that target is taken from the shell first. If fully depleted, the shell will explode, dealing area damage and firing a projectile at another target to apply a new shell to it. If multiple projectiles are fired by an exploding shell, only the first one to hit a target can apply a shell.

Frostbite.name: Frostbite
Frostbite.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their cold resistance and giving them a chance to be frozen when hit.

Hydrosphere.name: Hydrosphere
Hydrosphere.description: Create a sphere of water, or move an existing sphere and reset its duration. The sphere continually applies a drenched debuff with a short duration to enemies in its area or those it moves through. You can hit the sphere with other skills to inflict Cold and Lightning Ailments (other than Chill). The sphere pulses when created, at regular intervals while afflicted by an Ailment, and after moving, damaging all drenched enemies in a large area.

PurityOfElements.name: Purity of Elements
PurityOfElements.description: Casts an aura that grants elemental resistances and elemental ailment immunity to you and your allies.

CreepingFrostAltX.name: Creeping Frost of Floes
CreepingFrostAltX.description: Fire a single icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep rapidly across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.

WaveOfConvictionAltY.name: Wave of Conviction of Trarthus
WaveOfConvictionAltY.description: An expanding wave of energy surges outwards from you, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration. The ring then returns, damaging enemies again on the way back. Only one Wave of Conviction can be active at a time

FrostWall.name: Frost Wall
FrostWall.description: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back.

Automation.name: Automation
Automation.description: While this skill is active, supported spells will be repeatedly triggered.

BallLightningAltX.name: Ball Lightning of Orbiting
BallLightningAltX.description: Fires a single projectile which moves in a spiral while damaging each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

WallOfForce.name: Wall of Force
WallOfForce.description: Creates a wall of force which allies and enemies can pass through, but allied projectiles which can collide with enemies will also collide with this wall, and can chain from it to other targets. Projectiles can only collide with a single Wall of Force, and no more than once.

VaalFireball.name: Vaal Fireball
VaalFireball.description: Launches a series of fireballs in a spiral around the caster.

VortexAltX.name: Vortex of Projection
VortexAltX.description: An icy blast explodes around the caster, dealing cold damage to enemies, and leaving behind a whirling vortex which deals cold damage over time and chills enemies caught in it. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will explode from a number of those projectiles instead, destroying them.

EnergyBlade.name: Energy Blade
EnergyBlade.description: Grants a buff which significantly lowers your maximum Energy Shield to transform your equipped weapons into Swords formed from that energy. Casting the spell again removes the buff. Requires a Non-Bow weapon. This skill cannot be triggered.

VoltaxicBurst.name: Voltaxic Burst
VoltaxicBurst.description: Each cast of this spell waits for a short duration, releasing a burst of lightning and chaos spell damage in an area around you when that duration ends. Enemies killed by this damage, or shortly after, will explode. The explosions of the corpses are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

VaalLightningTrap.name: Vaal Lightning Trap
VaalLightningTrap.description: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets and leaving a trail of shocked ground.

IcicleMineAltX.name: Icicle Mine of Fanning
IcicleMineAltX.description: Throws a mine that fires projectiles at enemies when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.

Vortex.name: Vortex
Vortex.description: An icy blast explodes around the caster, dealing cold damage to enemies, and leaving behind a whirling vortex which deals cold damage over time and chills enemies caught in it.

TempestShield.name: Tempest Shield
TempestShield.description: Enchants your shield with the power of storms, which lashes out to deal arcing lightning damage to attackers when you block them.

FlameblastAltX.name: Flameblast of Celerity
FlameblastAltX.description: Channels to build up an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill or automatically at maximum stages. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.

ElementalWeakness.name: Elemental Weakness
ElementalWeakness.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their elemental resistances.

KineticBlastAltX.name: Kinetic Blast of Clustering
KineticBlastAltX.description: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.

VaalSummonSkeletons.name: Vaal Summon Skeletons
VaalSummonSkeletons.description: Summons an army of skeletal soldiers, archers and mages, led by a powerful general.

ArmageddonBrandAltX.name: Armageddon Brand of Volatility
ArmageddonBrandAltX.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It activates once, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky, then is destroyed.

PenanceBrand.name: Penance Brand
PenanceBrand.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy. When the branded enemy reaches 20 energy, a large explosion occurs and the brand is removed. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.

FrostblinkAltX.name: Frostblink of Wintry Blast
FrostblinkAltX.description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies in an area at both ends of the teleport. Deals higher damage to chilled enemies, then removes chill from them. Cannot be supported by Unleash.

OrbOfStormsAltX.name: Orb of Storms of Squalls
OrbOfStormsAltX.description: Creates an electrical orb that will strike enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning when placed, as well as when you use a lightning skill while within its area. These beams of lightning can then split to hit more enemies. When striking enemies, this orb will teleport to a random enemy struck. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.

BlazingSalvo.name: Blazing Salvo
BlazingSalvo.description: Fires projectiles which fly in an arc, dealing area damage on impact with either enemies or the ground near where you target. Targeting farther away causes the projectiles to spread out and land over a wider area.

SummonSkeletons.name: Summon Skeletons
SummonSkeletons.description: Summon Skeleton Warrior minions at the targeted location. They use a melee attack and die after a duration. If made aggressive, Skeleton Warriors will also dash towards nearby enemies.

DivineRetribution.name: Divine Retribution
DivineRetribution.description: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a surge of divine power, causing multiple waves of lightning bursts to expand outward from a targeted location. This skill cannot be Triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

SummonReaperAltY.name: Summon Reaper of Eviscerating
SummonReaperAltY.description: Summons a powerful Reaper which passively follows you without attacking enemies. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack. Cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

ArcAltY.name: Arc of Oscillating
ArcAltY.description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy, but this secondary arc cannot chain further.

Spark.name: Spark
Spark.description: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

SoulrendAltY.name: Soulrend of the Spiral
SoulrendAltY.description: Fires a series of projectiles in a spiral that turn towards enemies in front of them, damaging and piercing through those they hit, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectiles travel, they repeatedly apply a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around them.

FrostShield.name: Frost Shield
FrostShield.description: Place a Frost Shield that drains your energy shield for one second or until you run out, gaining stages while this drain occurs. The Frost Shield takes some damage from hits in place of you and allies while in its area. Enemies in the area are Chilled. You can only have one Frost Shield active at once.

SoulLink.name: Soul Link
SoulLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your Energy Shield will intercept some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

LightningSpireTrapAltX.name: Lightning Spire Trap of Zapping
LightningSpireTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.

parts.name: Average waves hitting configured size enemy

Malevolence.name: Malevolence
Malevolence.description: Casts an aura that multiplies damage over time and increases skill effect duration of you and your allies.

FirestormAltY.name: Firestorm of Pelting
FirestormAltY.description: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

LightningWarp.name: Lightning Warp
LightningWarp.description: Waits for a duration before teleporting to a targeted destination, with the duration based on the distance and your movement speed. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the area around both where the player was and where they teleported to. Casting again will queue up multiple teleportations to occur in sequence.

Flameblast.name: Flameblast
Flameblast.description: Channels to build up a large explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.

SummonCarrionGolemAltY.name: Summon Carrion Golem of Scavenging
SummonCarrionGolemAltY.description: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, can consume corpses to heal itself and gain the ability to unleash a devastating cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.

SummonLightningGolemAltX.name: Summon Lightning Golem of Hordes
SummonLightningGolemAltX.description: Summons a Lightning Golem. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.

RighteousFireAltX.name: Righteous Fire of Arcane Devotion
RighteousFireAltX.description: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your cast speed is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining. Requires mana.

SiphoningTrapAltX.name: Siphoning Trap of Pain
SiphoningTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time.

SummonLightningGolem.name: Summon Lightning Golem
SummonLightningGolem.description: Summons a Lightning Golem that grants you increased attack and cast speed, and mana regeneration. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.

VaalRighteousFire.name: Vaal Righteous Fire
VaalRighteousFire.description: Sacrifices a portion of your Life and Energy Shield to engulf you in magical fire that rapidly burns nearby enemies for a duration. Your spell damage is increased while under this effect.

CreepingFrost.name: Creeping Frost
CreepingFrost.description: Fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.

FrostBomb.name: Frost Bomb
FrostBomb.description: Creates a crystal that pulses with cold for a duration. Each pulse applies a debuff to nearby enemies for a secondary duration which reduces life regeneration rate, and also inflicts Cold Exposure. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.

SummonSkeletonsAltY.name: Summon Skeletons of Mages
SummonSkeletonsAltY.description: Summon Skeleton Mage minions of random elemental types at the targeted location. They cast projectile spells based on their element, and die after a duration.

SummonChaosGolemAltY.baseTypeName: Summon Chaos Golem of the Maelström
SummonChaosGolemAltY.name: Summon Chaos Golem of the Maelström
SummonChaosGolemAltY.description: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a powerful damage over time Chaos aura that Withers enemies in addition to its melee attack.

SummonChaosGolemAltX.name: Summon Chaos Golem of Hordes
SummonChaosGolemAltX.description: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.

SummonChaosGolem.name: Summon Chaos Golem
SummonChaosGolem.description: Summons a Chaos Golem that grants you damage over time and chaos resistance. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.

StormBurstAltX.name: Storm Burst of Repulsion
StormBurstAltX.description: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump away from the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.

SummonCarrionGolemAltX.name: Summon Carrion Golem of Hordes
SummonCarrionGolemAltX.description: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes.

IncinerateAltY.name: Incinerate of Venting
IncinerateAltY.description: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you.

SummonCarrionGolem.name: Summon Carrion Golem
SummonCarrionGolem.description: Summons a Carrion Golem that grants added physical damage for your non-golem minions. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.

DarkPact.name: Dark Pact
DarkPact.description: This spell removes some life from one of your Skeleton minions near you or the targeted location to deal chaos damage in an area around it. This effect will chain to your other nearby skeletons. If you have no skeletons near you or the targeted location, it will sacrifice your own life to deal damage instead.

IceNovaAltY.name: Ice Nova of Deep Freeze
IceNovaAltY.description: A circle of ice expands from the caster.

VaalClarity.name: Vaal Clarity
VaalClarity.description: Casts a temporary aura that lets you and your allies cast skills without paying their mana costs.

CracklingLanceAltY.name: Crackling Lance of Disintegration
CracklingLanceAltY.description: Release a concentrated beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you.

FlameWall.name: Flame Wall
FlameWall.description: Create a wall of fire for a duration, which deals burning damage to everything in its area. Each enemy that enters the wall also receives a secondary burning debuff which persists for a short duration after leaving the wall. Any projectiles fired through the wall by you and allies deal added fire damage and apply the wall's secondary debuff on hit.

StormCallAltX.name: Storm Call of Trarthus
StormCallAltX.description: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, a bolt strikes the marker, dealing physical damage around it and causing bolts to strike at any other markers you've cast. Bolt impacts will leave behind a pool of boiling blood, which deals physical damage over time to enemies within it for a secondary duration.

StormCall.name: Storm Call
StormCall.description: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it and causing lightning strikes at any other markers you've cast.

Blight.name: Blight
Blight.description: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.

Enfeeble.name: Enfeeble
Enfeeble.description: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.

VaalDiscipline.name: Vaal Discipline
VaalDiscipline.description: Casts a temporary aura that prevents energy shield recharge being delayed by damage taken for you and your allies.

IceSpearAltX.name: Ice Spear of Splitting
IceSpearAltX.description: Launches a shard of ice that splits on hitting terrain or enemies. After splitting, the projectiles are in second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

PurifyingFlameAltX.name: Purifying Flame of Revelations
PurifyingFlameAltX.description: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.

Clarity.name: Clarity
Clarity.description: Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies.

BlightAltX.name: Blight of Contagion
BlightAltX.description: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration. The damaging debuff is spread by Contagion.

FlameDash.name: Flame Dash
FlameDash.description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

DarkPactAltX.name: Dark Pact of Trarthus
DarkPactAltX.description: This spell deals chaos damage in an area around you. Casting this spell will cause you to gain Ruin. If this spell inflicts your seventh Ruin, it will sacrifice a large portion of your life to deal extra chaos damage based on the amount sacrificed, and remove all Ruin from you.

DischargeAltX.name: Discharge of Misery
DischargeAltX.description: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.

DestructiveLink.name: Destructive Link
DestructiveLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your main hand critical strike chance. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

GalvanicFieldAltX.name: Galvanic Field of Intensity
GalvanicFieldAltX.description: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning.

LightningSpireTrapAltY.name: Lightning Spire Trap of Overloading
LightningSpireTrapAltY.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.

parts.name: Average waves hitting configured size enemy

GalvanicField.name: Galvanic Field
GalvanicField.description: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning. The strength of the field depends on the magnitude of shock affecting the enemy when it is created.

BrandRecall.name: Brand Recall
BrandRecall.description: Recall your brands to you, detaching them from enemies and increasing attachment range until they next attach to an enemy. Spends a portion of each recalled brand's cost to cause it to activate.

StormBurst.name: Storm Burst
StormBurst.description: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump towards the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.

RuneBlastAltX.name: Rune Blast of Teleportation
RuneBlastAltX.description: Channel to improve runes placed by Stormbind based on the mana you spend channelling this skill. Release to detonate the targeted rune, which will cause other runes to detonate in a chain reaction. Detonation can teleport you to the targeted Rune.

RollingMagma.name: Rolling Magma
RollingMagma.description: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times.

StormbindAltX.name: Stormbind of Teleportation
StormbindAltX.description: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.

BoneOffering.name: Bone Offering
BoneOffering.description: Consumes a corpse, granting all of your minions the power to block both attacks and spells. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

VaalIceNova.name: Vaal Ice Nova
VaalIceNova.description: A chilling circle of ice expands from the caster, repeating from every enemy it hits.

Bodyswap.name: Bodyswap
Bodyswap.description: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or corpse, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise corpses over enemies. If targeting a corpse, the corpse will also explode, dealing damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.

RuneBlast.name: Rune Blast
RuneBlast.description: Channel to improve runes placed by Stormbind based on the mana you spend channelling this skill. Release to detonate the targeted rune, which will cause other runes to detonate in a chain reaction.

StormblastMine.name: Stormblast Mine
StormblastMine.description: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated.

FirestormAltX.name: Firestorm of Meteors
FirestormAltX.description: A large flaming bolt falls towards the targeted area. The bolt explodes when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

SummonRagingSpirit.name: Summon Raging Spirit
SummonRagingSpirit.description: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

ArcAltX.name: Arc of Surging
ArcAltX.description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and splits to simultaneously hit several other enemies.

Firestorm.name: Firestorm
Firestorm.description: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

SparkAltX.name: Spark of the Nova
SparkAltX.description: Launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

Discharge.name: Discharge
Discharge.description: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.

SummonReaperAltX.name: Summon Reaper of Revenants
SummonReaperAltX.description: Summons a Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The presence of any Reapers weakens your other non-Reaper minions, and Reapers will consume them to temporarily empower and heal themselves.

RaiseZombie.name: Raise Zombie
RaiseZombie.description: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike.

HeraldOfThunder.name: Herald of Thunder
HeraldOfThunder.description: Grants a buff which adds lightning damage to spells and attacks. If you kill a shocked enemy, this skill will create a storm, causing lightning bolts to strike enemies around you for a duration. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

EssenceDrain.name: Essence Drain
EssenceDrain.description: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.

IceNovaAltX.name: Ice Nova of Frostbolts
IceNovaAltX.description: A circle of ice expands from the caster. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will expand from a number of those projectiles instead. If this skill would repeat when cast this way, it will instead expand again from the same projectiles after a short delay.

FlameblastAltY.name: Flameblast of Contraction
FlameblastAltY.description: Channels to concentrate an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the damage of the explosion, but the smaller the area.

ArcaneCloak.name: Arcane Cloak
ArcaneCloak.description: Spends a portion of your mana to grant a buff that takes some of the damage from hits for you until depleted. The buff grants added lightning damage based on the amount of mana spent by this skill. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

FlameSurgeAltX.name: Flame Surge of Combusting
FlameSurgeAltX.description: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. If this ignites an enemy a large area of burning ground will be created under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.

Hexblast.name: Hexblast
Hexblast.description: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way.

WintertideBrand.name: Wintertide Brand
WintertideBrand.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy, dealing cold damage over time and chilling them. It periodically activates while attached, gaining stages that raise the damage. When removed, a short-duration debuff dealing the same damage over time and chill is applied to each nearby enemy. The brand keeps its charges while detached.

SigilOfPower.name: Sigil of Power
SigilOfPower.description: Places a Sigil on the ground, which grants a buff to you and allies in the area around it for a duration. The Sigil gains stages as you spend mana in its area, making the buff more powerful. You can only have one Sigil of Power at a time.

Flammability.name: Flammability
Flammability.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their fire resistance and giving them a chance to be ignited when hit.

PowerSiphonAltX.name: Power Siphon of the Archmage
PowerSiphonAltX.description: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.

EyeOfWinterAltX.name: Eye of Winter of Finality
EyeOfWinterAltX.description: Fires a single eye projectile which cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a fast spiral of shards. The shards will deal cold damage to enemies they impact.

AssassinsMark.name: Assassin's Mark
AssassinsMark.description: Curses a single enemy, making them more vulnerable to Critical Strikes. Killing the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and a power charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

ShockNovaAltX.name: Shock Nova of Procession
ShockNovaAltX.description: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage. This then repeats, with each repeat offset from the previous in the direction you target.

BodyswapAltX.name: Bodyswap of Sacrifice
BodyswapAltX.description: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or damageable minion, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise minions over enemies. If targeting a minion, the minion will also be destroyed in an explosion which deals damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.

ShockNova.name: Shock Nova
ShockNova.description: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.

KineticRain.name: Kinetic Rain
KineticRain.description: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage and triggering Kinetic Anomaly. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

CracklingLance.name: Crackling Lance
CracklingLance.description: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.

FleshOffering.name: Flesh Offering
FleshOffering.description: Consumes a corpse, which temporarily empowers your minions with swiftness. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

PenanceBrandAltX.name: Penance Brand of Dissipation
PenanceBrandAltX.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and causing a pulse that deals damage to the branded enemy and other nearby enemies. The pulse gains area of effect and damage for each energy on the branded enemy, up to 20. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.

IcicleMineAltY.name: Icicle Mine of Sabotage
IcicleMineAltY.description: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.

ScorchingRayAltX.name: Scorching Ray of Immolation
ScorchingRayAltX.description: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.

PyroclastMine.name: Pyroclast Mine

args: Area in which projectiles will land:

PyroclastMine.description: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.

ScorchingRay.name: Scorching Ray
ScorchingRay.description: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Inflicts Fire Exposure at maximum stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.

PenanceBrandAltY.name: Penance Brand of Conduction
PenanceBrandAltY.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and nearby enemies who do not have energy. When the brand is detached, all enemies with energy are dealt damage.

SummonHolyRelicAltX.name: Summon Holy Relic of Conviction
SummonHolyRelicAltX.description: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies in an area around a nearby enemy.

RighteousFire.name: Righteous Fire
RighteousFire.description: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your spell damage is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining.

ContagionAltY.name: Contagion of Transference
ContagionAltY.description: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy is hit while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.

HexblastAltY.name: Hexblast of Havoc
HexblastAltY.description: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target.

Bane.name: Bane
Bane.description: Applies a debuff to enemies in an area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

RaiseZombieAltY.name: Raise Zombie of Falling
RaiseZombieAltY.description: Raises necromantic energies into the sky above a targeted location, where they coalesce into a zombie minion. The minion then attacks by falling to the ground, causing an impact that deals damage in an area. The zombie cannot survive the impact.

LightningTendrilsAltX.name: Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity
LightningTendrilsAltX.description: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.

SoulrendAltX.name: Soulrend of Reaping
SoulrendAltX.description: Fires a projectile that deals chaos damage to enemies it hits and leeches some of that damage as energy shield.

CracklingLanceAltX.name: Crackling Lance of Branching
CracklingLanceAltX.description: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.

RaiseSpectreAltX.name: Raise Spectre of Transience
RaiseSpectreAltX.description: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a temporary minion to fight for you in battle for a duration.

BallLightningAltY.name: Ball Lightning of Static
BallLightningAltY.description: Creates a ball of lightning at a location that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning. Cannot be supported by Spell Echo or used by Totems.

RaiseSpectre.name: Raise Spectre
RaiseSpectre.description: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a minion to fight for you in battle.

HexblastAltX.name: Hexblast of Contradiction
HexblastAltX.description: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way.

PyroclastMineAltX.name: Pyroclast Mine of Sabotage

args: Area in which projectiles will land:

PyroclastMineAltX.description: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.

VaalImpurityOfLightning.name: Vaal Impurity of Lightning
VaalImpurityOfLightning.description: Casts an aura that reduces lightning damage taken and provides shock immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their lightning resistance.

Discipline.name: Discipline
Discipline.description: Casts an aura that grants additional energy shield and increased energy shield recharge rate to you and your allies.

PurifyingFlame.name: Purifying Flame
PurifyingFlame.description: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.

ContagionAltX.name: Contagion of Subsiding
ContagionAltX.description: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies, but each time it spreads, it only deals three quarters as much damage as before.

SummonHolyRelic.name: Summon Holy Relic
SummonHolyRelic.description: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a nova spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies and grants life regeneration to allies in an area around it. This life regeneration is higher when applied to minions.

IcicleMine.name: Icicle Mine
IcicleMine.description: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.

Contagion.name: Contagion
Contagion.description: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.

SummonSkeletonsAltX.name: Summon Skeletons of Archers
SummonSkeletonsAltX.description: Summon Skeleton Archer minions at the targeted location. They fire arrows and die after a duration.

OrbOfStorms.name: Orb of Storms
OrbOfStorms.description: Creates a stationary electrical orb that strikes enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning that can then split to hit more enemies. Modifiers to cast speed will increase how frequently it does this. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.

Manabond.name: Manabond
Manabond.description: Deals lightning damage based upon your missing mana in a circular area around the targeted location, as well as in four rectangular extensions whose lengths depend upon your remaining mana.

VaalLightningWarpInstant.name: Vaal Lightning Warp
VaalLightningWarpInstant.description: Casts a delayed teleport for nearby enemies to a target destination. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the enemies both before and after they teleport.

LightningTrapAltX.name: Lightning Trap of Sparking
LightningTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap that launches projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.

LightningTendrilsAltY.name: Lightning Tendrils of Escalation
LightningTendrilsAltY.description: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a growing semicircular area in front of you.

SummonSkitterbots.name: Summon Skitterbots
SummonSkitterbots.description: Summon a Chilling Skitterbot and a Shocking Skitterbot, which will trigger your traps and detonate your mines. Mines detonated by Skitterbots will re-arm and can then be detonated again. The Skitterbots grant you more trap and mine damage, and cannot be targeted or damaged.

SummonReaper.name: Summon Reaper
SummonReaper.description: Summons a powerful Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack.

KineticBlast.name: Kinetic Blast
KineticBlast.description: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.

VaalColdSnap.name: Vaal Cold Snap
VaalColdSnap.description: Creates a sudden burst of cold around you, damaging enemies. This also creates a chilling area around you which expands and deals cold damage over time to surrounding enemies in addition to chilling them. Enemies that die while in the area grant Frenzy Charges, and you will passively gain Frenzy Charges while there are enemies in the area.

LightningTendrils.name: Lightning Tendrils
LightningTendrils.description: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.

SiphoningTrap.name: Siphoning Trap
SiphoningTrap.description: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time. A beam is also applied to you, granting life and mana regeneration based on the number of debuff beams affecting enemies.

DivineIreAltX.name: Divine Ire of Holy Lightning
DivineIreAltX.description: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a powerful burst around you. Maximum of 10 Stages.

VaalPowerSiphon.name: Vaal Power Siphon
VaalPowerSiphon.description: Fires your wand simultaneously at all nearby enemies, culling those close to death and granting you a power charge for each. Cannot be supported by Volley.

ConversionTrap.name: Conversion Trap
ConversionTrap.description: Throws a trap that, when triggered by an enemy, converts that enemy to your side for a short duration. Does not affect unique monsters or players.

SupportBrandSupport.name: Arcanist Brand
SupportBrandSupport.description: Supports spell skills that have no reservation. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SparkAltY.name: Spark of Unpredictability
SparkAltY.description: Launches unpredictable sparks with that move randomly with large differences in speed and distance until they hit an enemy or expire.

GlacialCascade.name: Glacial Cascade
GlacialCascade.description: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area and knocking them back in the direction of the next burst.

VaalFlameblast.name: Vaal Flameblast
VaalFlameblast.description: Targets an area and builds up stages in that area based on cast speed. It explodes every 3 stages, until it reaches a maximum of 15. As it gains more stages, the area gets smaller but the damage gets higher.

LightningSpireTrap.name: Lightning Spire Trap
LightningSpireTrap.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.

parts.name: Average waves hitting configured size enemy

EyeOfWinter.name: Eye of Winter
EyeOfWinter.description: Fires a single eye projectile which constantly releases shard projectiles in a spiral. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a faster spiral of extra shards.

EyeOfWinterAltY.name: Eye of Winter of Transience
EyeOfWinterAltY.description: Fires a single eye projectile which releases a number shard projectiles in a spiral before dissipating. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies.

Despair.name: Despair
Despair.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their chaos resistance.

VoidSphere.name: Void Sphere
VoidSphere.description: Creates a Void Sphere which Hinders enemies in an area around it, with the debuff being stronger on enemies closer to the sphere. It also regularly releases pulses of area damage. The Void Sphere will consume the corpses of any enemies which die in its area. Can only have one Void Sphere at a time.

KineticBoltAltX.name: Kinetic Bolt of Fragmentation
KineticBoltAltX.description: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from. Multiple of these projectiles can hit the same target.

Conductivity.name: Conductivity
Conductivity.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their lightning resistance and giving them a chance to be shocked when hit.

WaveOfConviction.name: Wave of Conviction
WaveOfConviction.description: An expanding wave of energy surges forward, damaging enemies in a cone-shaped area over a duration. Each enemy hit is inflicted with Exposure matching the element of which they took the highest damage. Only one Wave of Conviction can be active at a time

VaalBlight.name: Vaal Blight
VaalBlight.description: Apply a powerful debuff to enemies around you which deals chaos damage over time. Then applies two additional layers in a larger area, growing greatly in size each time. Enemies are also substantially hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement.

LightningConduit.name: Lightning Conduit
LightningConduit.description: Lightning strikes all Shocked enemies around a targeted location, then removes Shock from those enemies. Shocks cannot expire on enemies in range while casting this spell. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade or Unleash.

VaalStormCall.name: Vaal Storm Call
VaalStormCall.description: Sets a marker at a location. Lightning strikes random enemies around the marker repeatedly over the skill's duration, dealing damage in an area around the strike. Modifiers to the skill's duration will also affect the delay between these strikes. When the duration ends, a large bolt of lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it.

EssenceDrainAltX.name: Essence Drain of Desperation
EssenceDrainAltX.description: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You lose Life and Energy Shield equal to a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.

Arc.name: Arc
Arc.description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.

IceSpear.name: Ice Spear
IceSpear.description: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

FrostBombAltX.name: Frost Bomb of Instability
FrostBombAltX.description: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing cold damage to enemies around it.

EssenceDrainAltY.name: Essence Drain of Wickedness
EssenceDrainAltY.description: Fires a piercing projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage.

VoidSphereAltX.name: Void Sphere of Rending
VoidSphereAltX.description: Creates a Void Sphere which Hinders enemies in an area around it, with the debuff being stronger on enemies closer to the sphere. It also regularly releases pulses of area damage. The Void Sphere will consume the corpses of any enemies which die in its area. Can only have one Void Sphere at a time.

BrandSupport.name: Arcanist Brand
BrandSupport.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, triggering linked spells. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

DivineIre.name: Divine Ire
DivineIre.description: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a burst around you and a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect the beam. Maximum of 10 Stages.

ArmageddonBrandAltY.name: Armageddon Brand of Recall
ArmageddonBrandAltY.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

ArmageddonBrand.name: Armageddon Brand
ArmageddonBrand.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

FrostBombAltY.name: Frost Bomb of Forthcoming
FrostBombAltY.description: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.

SupportSpellslinger.name: Spellslinger
SupportSpellslinger.description: Supports spell skills that have no reservation. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

Frostblink.name: Frostblink
Frostblink.description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving Chilled ground in an area at both ends of the teleport. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

FlameSurge.name: Flame Surge
FlameSurge.description: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.

ColdSnapAltX.name: Cold Snap of Power
ColdSnapAltX.description: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.

Soulrend.name: Soulrend
Soulrend.description: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it, damaging and piercing through those it hits, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectile travels, it repeatedly applies a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it.

ForbiddenRite.name: Forbidden Rite
ForbiddenRite.description: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your life and energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.

FrostBolt.name: Frostbolt
FrostBolt.description: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage.

StormBrand.name: Storm Brand
StormBrand.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing beams which deal damage to nearby enemies and those around them. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

LightningConduitAltX.name: Lightning Conduit of the Heavens
LightningConduitAltX.description: Lightning strikes a number of enemies around a targeted location. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

GlacialCascadeAltX.name: Glacial Cascade of the Fissure
GlacialCascadeAltX.description: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.

VaalArc.name: Vaal Arc
VaalArc.description: A shocking arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains from an enemy, it will do so simultaneously to two further enemies, but never to enemies that have already been hit by any of these chains. Also grants a buff making your Arc damage lucky for a short duration.

KineticFusillade.name: Kinetic Fusillade
KineticFusillade.description: Wave your wand to create a hovering kinetic projectile. After a short duration, the projectile is fired at an enemy, dealing area damage on impact and chaining to further targets. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Multiple projectiles fired in sequence will attempt to target different enemies. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.

IncinerateAltX.name: Incinerate of Expanse
IncinerateAltX.description: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a slow-moving wave of fire damage over a very large area that will apply a powerful Ignite.

BlightAltY.name: Blight of Atrophy
BlightAltY.description: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a longer secondary duration, slowing their movement and reducing their life regeneration rate. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.

VaalFirestorm.name: Vaal Firestorm
VaalFirestorm.description: A fixed number of flaming bolts rain down in a spiral, culminating in the central one impacting the targeted location. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies and leaving burning ground, which deals fire damage over time.

ForbiddenRiteAltX.name: Forbidden Rite of Soul Sacrifice
ForbiddenRiteAltX.description: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.

Snipe.name: Snipe
Snipe.description: Channel to charge up your bow, gaining stages. Release to trigger one supported bow skill for each stage gained. If there are no supported skills, but at least one stage was gained, this skill will fire its own arrow instead. Cannot be used by Totems.

SpectralShieldThrowAltY.name: Spectral Shield Throw of Trarthus
SpectralShieldThrowAltY.description: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a piercing projectile which deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it reaches the targeted location it will hover in place, repeatedly firing a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. The rate at which it releases shards will increase until all shards have been fired. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

SmokeMine.name: Smoke Mine
SmokeMine.description: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

VaalDetonateDead.name: Vaal Detonate Dead
VaalDetonateDead.description: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with an increasing delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 22 corpses.

VaalGrace.name: Vaal Grace
VaalGrace.description: Casts a temporary aura that grants you and your allies additional chance to evade attacks, and makes suppressed spell damage unlucky against you.

ExplosiveConcoctionAltX.name: Explosive Concoction of Destruction
ExplosiveConcoctionAltX.description: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

DoubleStrikeAltX.name: Double Strike of Impaling
DoubleStrikeAltX.description: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.

TornadoAltY.name: Tornado of Elemental Turbulence
TornadoAltY.description: Create a Tornado of a random element that hinders and repeatedly damages enemies around it, converting physical damage to its element. The Tornado will chase down enemies for a duration.

LightningArrow.name: Lightning Arrow
LightningArrow.description: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.

SnipersMark.name: Sniper's Mark
SnipersMark.description: Curses a single enemy, increasing the damage they take from projectiles, and making projectiles split when hitting them, to hit other targets around them. You can only have one Mark at a time.

EtherealKnives.name: Ethereal Knives
EtherealKnives.description: Fires an arc of knives outwards in front of the caster which deal physical damage.

StormRain.name: Storm Rain
StormRain.description: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.

CobraLash.name: Cobra Lash
CobraLash.description: Fires a poisonous projectile based on your weapon that will chain between enemies. Requires a Dagger or Claw.

FrenzyAltX.name: Frenzy of Onslaught
FrenzyAltX.description: Perform a strike with a melee weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.

ShrapnelBallistaAltX.name: Shrapnel Ballista of Steel
ShrapnelBallistaAltX.description: Summons a ballista totem that consumes your Steel Shards to fire multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

LacerateAltY.name: Lacerate of Haemorrhage
LacerateAltY.description: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a One Handed Axe or One Handed Sword.

BladefallAltX.name: Bladefall of Volleys
BladefallAltX.description: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys, each wider and more damaging than the last. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.

PoisonousConcoctionAltX.name: Poisonous Concoction of Bouncing
PoisonousConcoctionAltX.description: Throws a single bottle that releases a burst when it hits the ground, dealing unarmed attack damage in an area with a chance to poison. The skill chains, bouncing randomly to deal damage multiple times. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

ExplosiveTrap.name: Explosive Trap
ExplosiveTrap.description: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.

BurningArrowAltX.name: Burning Arrow of Vigour
BurningArrowAltX.description: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.

DetonateDead.name: Detonate Dead
DetonateDead.description: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.

VaalReave.name: Vaal Reave
VaalReave.description: Repeatedly attacks a large area in different directions. Each Vaal Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

ShrapnelBallista.name: Shrapnel Ballista
ShrapnelBallista.description: Summons a ballista totem that fires multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow.

DetonateDeadAltX.name: Detonate Dead of Scavenging
DetonateDeadAltX.description: Targets a corpse, causing it to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. Cannot target corpses that have been created by skills.

GlacialShieldSwipe.name: Glacial Shield Swipe
GlacialShieldSwipe.description: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of ice in a cone in front of you.

ArcticArmour.name: Arctic Armour
ArcticArmour.description: Conjures an icy barrier that chills enemies when they hit you. You drop chilled ground while moving, and take less Fire and Physical damage while stationary.

SpectralThrow.name: Spectral Throw
SpectralThrow.description: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then returns to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in its path.

BladeBlastAltX.name: Blade Blast of Unloading
BladeBlastAltX.description: Deals spell damage in an area around you. If you have Blade Vortex blades orbiting you, it will detonate each of them in turn, dealing damage again in an area around you for each one.

IceShotAltX.name: Ice Shot of Penetration
IceShotAltX.description: Fires a piercing arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in two cones perpendicular to the target.

SplittingSteel.name: Splitting Steel
SplittingSteel.description: Fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe.

CallOfSteel.name: Call of Steel
CallOfSteel.description: Calls impale debuffs from enemies, alive or dead, in a large area around you to gain steel shards. Deals reflected damage in a smaller area around each such enemy based on the impales removed from them. Continues to grant shards over time until you reach maximum or spend them.

CycloneAltX.name: Cyclone of Tumult
CycloneAltX.description: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.

Precision.name: Precision
Precision.description: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.

ChargedDashAltX.name: Charged Dash of Projection
ChargedDashAltX.description: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to release the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.

BladeBlastAltY.name: Blade Blast of Dagger Detonation
BladeBlastAltY.description: Deals spell damage in an area around you. Your equipped daggers add to this damage.

VaalLightningArrow.name: Vaal Lightning Arrow
VaalLightningArrow.description: Fires charged arrows, which repeatedly travel for a short time before changing direction. When they hit enemies, they are struck by a bolt of lightning which damages a number of surrounding enemies.

Reave.name: Reave
Reave.description: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

EtherealKnivesAltY.name: Ethereal Knives of the Massacre
EtherealKnivesAltY.description: Fires a circle of knives outwards around the caster which deal physical damage.

PestilentStrike.name: Pestilent Strike
PestilentStrike.description: Attacks with your weapon, inflicting a debuff on enemies hit by the strike. If a debuffed enemy dies while poisoned, Pestilent Strike inflicts a secondary chaos damage over time debuff on enemies around them, based on the poisons on the slain enemy. This damage is not affected by your damage modifiers. Requires a Claw or Dagger.

BlinkArrowAltX.name: Blink Arrow of Bombarding Clones
BlinkArrowAltX.description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.

VaalRainOfArrows.name: Vaal Rain of Arrows
VaalRainOfArrows.description: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in multiple sequences after a delay, each starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

VaalArcticArmour.name: Vaal Arctic Armour
VaalArcticArmour.description: Immediately encases you in ice, protecting you for a duration or until you take damage from a number of hits, and also grants a buff once the cast time has finished. You cannot move or perform non-instant actions while in the ice. When the ice breaks, the buff is also removed.

BladeTrapAltX.name: Blade Trap of Greatswords
BladeTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Two Handed Sword around it in circles for a duration, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through

AlchemistsMark.name: Alchemist's Mark
AlchemistsMark.description: Curses a single enemy, granting flask charges when you hit them and creating Burning Ground under them if your hit Ignites them, and Caustic Ground if it Poisons them. Damage modifiers do not apply to these ground effects. You can only have one Mark at a time.

SplitArrowAltX.name: Split Arrow of Splitting
SplitArrowAltX.description: Fires an arrow that splits to hit different targets.

IceTrapAltX.name: Ice Trap of Hollowness
IceTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions in a circle around itself when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.

WildStrike.name: Wild Strike
WildStrike.description: Your melee weapon strikes enemies, converting physical damage to a random element. Then, depending on the element chosen, it releases a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.

BladeFlurry.name: Blade Flurry
BladeFlurry.description: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The damage is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

BlinkArrowAltY.name: Blink Arrow of Prismatic Clones
BlinkArrowAltY.description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.

VolatileDeadAltY.name: Volatile Dead of Seething
VolatileDeadAltY.description: Corpses near the targeted location explode, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

EnsnaringArrow.name: Ensnaring Arrow
EnsnaringArrow.description: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.

BearTrap.name: Bear Trap
BearTrap.description: Throws a trap that damages and immobilises a single enemy for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. After the immobilise expires, a debuff remains on the enemy for a duration, lowering their movement speed by an amount which lessens over time. The affected enemy will take increased damage from traps and mines until the debuff expires. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.

MirrorArrowAltY.name: Mirror Arrow of Prismatic Clones
MirrorArrowAltY.description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.

LightningArrowAltX.name: Lightning Arrow of Electrocution
LightningArrowAltX.description: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning. It sticks into the final target, causing them to be struck and damaged multiple times.

VaalBladeFlurry.name: Vaal Blade Flurry
VaalBladeFlurry.description: Channel to create an expanding circle area around you that blinds enemies within it. When you stop channelling, deals damage in a smaller area around each enemy in the circle. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

PoachersMark.name: Poacher's Mark
PoachersMark.description: Curses a single enemy, lowering their physical damage reduction, and adding physical damage to all hits against them. Attacking the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and killing them will grant a frenzy charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

SupportIntuitiveLink.name: Intuitive Link
SupportIntuitiveLink.description: Supports spell skills, causing them to be triggered by Intuitive Link. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

EtherealKnivesAltX.name: Ethereal Knives of Lingering Blades
EtherealKnivesAltX.description:
Fires an arc of knives down into the ground in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
Cannot be supported by Volley.

SplitArrow.name: Split Arrow
SplitArrow.description: Fires multiple arrows at different targets.

StormRainAltX.name: Storm Rain of the Conduit
StormRainAltX.description: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to you, dealing area damage between the arrow and you.

BurningArrow.name: Burning Arrow
BurningArrow.description: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.

DualStrike.name: Dual Strike
DualStrike.description: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.

FrostBlades.name: Frost Blades
FrostBlades.description: Attack enemies with increased range, releasing icy blades from the first enemy hit which fly at other enemies. Requires a Melee Weapon.

Hatred.name: Hatred
Hatred.description: Casts an aura that grants extra cold damage based on physical damage to you and your allies.

QuickstepHardMode.name: Quickstep
QuickstepHardMode.description: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location, stopping if you would overlap with monsters or terrain. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be supported.

IceTrap.name: Ice Trap
IceTrap.description: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.

GalvanicArrow.name: Galvanic Arrow
GalvanicArrow.description: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. The arrows are fired with such force that they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.

MirrorArrow.name: Mirror Arrow
MirrorArrow.description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.

HeraldOfAgony.name: Herald of Agony
HeraldOfAgony.description: Grants a buff giving more poison damage and a chance to inflict poison. When you poison an enemy while you have this buff, you gain Virulence, and summon an Agony Crawler minion that uses projectile and area attacks. You will lose Virulence over time, at a rate which increases the more Virulence you have. The minion will die when you have no Virulence.

FrostBladesAltX.name: Frost Blades of Katabasis
